g.title: Neepy - Eastern pigment version
g.desc: The Neepy N centred by ink-mass centroid on a vermilion mineral-pigment moon without an outer halo, aligned with the wordmark on the horizontal axis. Concentric, feathered sound waves to the left and a lifted vermilion three-arc echo at the y's upper right, a faint vertical divider, no bottom rule. The subline is justified from a fixed M to a G flush with the y of Neepy at even tracking. A narrow cinnabar-ground intaglio name seal straddles the moon's rim just below three o'clock.

g.inkscape:label: L1 声波半弧 / SOUND WAVES
L2 朱月与分隔线 / MOON & DIVIDER
